sentences.text:
Mayur Savkar Vidhate vs The State Of Maharashtra on 6
September, 2023

Author: N.J.Jamadar
Bench: N.J.Jamadar

22 aba 977 of 2023
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction

Anticipatory Bail Application No.977 Of 2023
Mayur Savkar Vidhate ... Applicant
 versus
The State of Maharashtra ... Respondent
Mr. Onkar A. Mane, for applicant.
Mr. R.M.Pethe, App for State.

Coram: N.J.Jamadar, J.
 Date : 6 September 2023
P.C.
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R.No.43 o 2022 registered with Junnar Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 26(2), 26(4), 30(2)(a) of the Foods Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. On 4 February 2023 in a raid conducted at a shed in front of the house of Mr. Vidhate at Village Shiroli, contraband articles (gutkha - panmasala) were found to have been stored.
The said contraband articles were allegedly stored by the Applicant.
4. By an order dated 3 April 2023, this Court had granted interim protection.
Evidently, the contraband articles have been seized and samples have been collected.

The question as to whether in a case of the present nature, the provisions of Section 328 of the IPC can be invoked, awaits decision of the Supreme Mayur Savkar Vidhate vs The State Of Maharashtra on 6 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37488206/
1

entities.text: Supreme Mayur Savkar Vidhate vs The State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: SSP 1/2
Court.
5. In the aforesaid backdrop, at this stage, further   the applicant does not seem to be warranted.

6. Hence, the following order :
 ORDER (i) In the event of the arrest of the Applicant - Mayur Savkar Vidhate in connection with C.R.No.43 of 2022 registered with Junnar Police Station, the Applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to any of the prosecution witnesses and the persons acquainted with the facts of the case.
(iii) The Applicant shall not indulge in identical activities for which he has been arraigned in the instant case.
(iv) The Application stands disposed.

( N.J.J Signed by: S.S.Phadke Designation: PS To Honourable Judge Date: 08/09/2023 18:25:17 Mayur Savkar Vidhate vs The State Of Maharashtra on 6 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37488206/
2
